title: Grill Mode
description:
**Category:** Poster Design, Environmental Awareness

The poster addresses global warming through a visual metaphor inspired by the mechanical timer switches found on old stoves and microwave ovens.

Planet Earth is transformed into a circular control dial with familiar cooking settings. The pointer is currently set to “Defrost,” suggesting that the planet is already heating up.

If global warming continues, the dial could move toward “Grill,” turning the Earth into something being cooked.

The poster uses dark humor and a familiar household object to illustrate the consequences of climate change and the danger of rising global temperatures.
